nodes.label: Expo Router
nodes.summary: File-based navigation framework (~v6) where every file under app/ is a route.

nodes.label: Root Layout (_layout.tsx)
nodes.summary: App entry layout that preloads fonts/assets, wraps the provider stack, and runs route guard logic.

nodes.label: Provider Stack
nodes.summary: Nested context providers from GestureHandlerRootView down to NutritionProvider wrapping the Expo Router Stack.

nodes.label: Route Guard Logic
nodes.summary: Logic in _layout.tsx routing to login (no session), onboarding (no onboarding), or tabs (loaded).

nodes.label: Onboarding Flow
nodes.summary: 10-step onboarding collecting birth date, gender, height, body weight, units, activity, goals, ending with macro reveal.

nodes.label: AuthContext
nodes.summary: Manages user, session, userID; provides signInWithApple, signOut, deleteAccount; drives PowerSync connect/disconnect.

nodes.label: BillingContext
nodes.summary: Wraps RevenueCat; exposes offerings, customerInfo, hasPremium; 15s timeout, app continues if billing fails.

nodes.label: SettingsContext
nodes.summary: Holds user profile, goals, macro targets, body weight; recalculates macros on BW update; persists via persistDirty flag.

nodes.label: NutritionContext
nodes.summary: Holds nutrition entries, saved meals, selected date, streak; integrates AI photo analysis and FoodDB.

nodes.label: WorkoutContext
nodes.summary: Holds workouts, exercises, logs, user exercises, exercise library, lastExercise; computes fatigue and ordering.

nodes.label: ThemeContext
nodes.summary: Manages light/dark color palette; exposes useColors, useColorScheme, useSetColorScheme; persisted to AsyncStorage.

nodes.label: PowerSync
nodes.summary: Offline-first local SQLite cache that syncs bidirectionally with Supabase Postgres; reads hit local, writes queue for upload.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.summary: Backend providing Postgres, Auth, and Edge Functions; client uses AsyncStorage session persistence.

nodes.label: AppSchema (10 tables)
nodes.summary: PowerSync table schema defining 10 tables mirrored between local SQLite and Supabase Postgres.

nodes.label: PowerSync Connector
nodes.summary: PowerSyncBackendConnector that fetches credentials and uploads CRUD queue to Supabase, handling per-table conflict resolution.

nodes.label: PowerSync Orchestrator
nodes.summary: Mutex-protected connection lifecycle: ensurePowerSyncConnected, disconnectPowerSync, kickPowerSync; skips reconnect when backgrounded.

nodes.label: FlushUploads (Gate C)
nodes.summary: flushUploadsOrThrow polls upload queue until empty (15s default) before sign-out to prevent data loss.

nodes.label: PowerSyncGuard
nodes.summary: Blocks rendering children until PowerSync status is Connected or Syncing, preventing stale/empty DB display.

nodes.label: SyncWatchdog
nodes.summary: Silent background monitor that polls PowerSync health and calls kickPowerSync if stale.

nodes.label: Apple Sign-In
nodes.summary: Native iOS sign-in via expo-apple-authentication; only auth method; exchanges identity token with Supabase.

nodes.label: RevenueCat
nodes.summary: In-app purchase SDK providing subscription offerings; entitlement key hardcoded as 'LiftTrition Pro'.

nodes.label: Supabase Edge Functions
nodes.summary: Single gateway for secrets; routes OpenAI (fetchOpenAI), FoodDB (fetchFoodDB), and deleteAccount calls so no API keys live in client.

nodes.label: OpenAI Library
nodes.summary: askOpenAIVision and askOpenAIText routing through fetchOpenAI Edge Function with 30s timeout; vision returns ingredient JSON.

nodes.label: OpenAI Vision API
nodes.summary: AI service used for photo-based food analysis; never called directly from client.

nodes.label: FoodDB Library
nodes.summary: getFoodSearchResults/getFoodDetails/getFoodItem via fetchFoodDB Edge Function; in-memory cache with 7-day TTL.

nodes.label: FatSecret API
nodes.summary: External food database accessed through the fetchFoodDB Edge Function.

nodes.label: Sentry
nodes.summary: Crash reporting and error tracking, wrapped at root; DSN configured in app.json.

nodes.label: AsyncStorage
nodes.summary: Lightweight KV store for session, preferences, theme, and per-device lastExercise.

nodes.label: victory-native
nodes.summary: Charting library rendering VictoryLine charts for workout and nutrition data.

nodes.label: Macro Calculation (Mifflin-St Jeor)
nodes.summary: Computes BMR/TDEE via Mifflin-St Jeor, adjusts for goal pace, splits macros by goal, and floors minimums.

nodes.label: 1RM Estimation (Epley)
nodes.summary: estimate1RM = weight × (1 + 0.0333 × reps); used for graph y-axis and fatigue refMax baseline.

nodes.label: Fatigue Calculation
nodes.summary: Per-set fatigue from load/currentMax, reps, RPE, and fatigueFactor; uses rolling 30-day refMax and activity-based daily budget.

nodes.label: Fatigue Factor
nodes.summary: Per-exercise multiplier derived from compound/isolation base plus muscle and equipment modifiers, clamped to [0.5, 1.1].

nodes.label: Nutrition Streak
nodes.summary: Computes loggedToday, streakIncludingToday, and streakThroughYesterday from consecutive logged days.

nodes.label: Graph Downsampling
nodes.summary: downsampleDataPreserveEndpoints keeps first/last points exact and averages the middle into buckets for charts.

nodes.label: dateHelper / getDateKey
nodes.summary: Canonical date utilities; getDateKey returns YYYY-MM-DD using en-CA locale for locale-safe ISO keys.

nodes.label: Unit Conversions
nodes.summary: Imperial/metric conversion helpers applied at context boundaries.

nodes.label: Exercise Library (dataV2)
nodes.summary: Active base exercise library in dataV2/ with 200+ images; legacy data/ folder is deprecated.

nodes.label: settings table
nodes.summary: One row per user holding profile, goals, and macro targets; Connector upserts.

nodes.label: weight_progress table
nodes.summary: Body weight per date, unique on (user_id, date); Connector upserts on conflict.

nodes.label: user_exercises table
nodes.summary: User custom exercises with muscles, fatigue_factor, equipment; arrays stored as Postgres array literals.

nodes.label: workouts table
nodes.summary: User workouts with name, order, archived, note; indexed by user_id.

nodes.label: exercises table
nodes.summary: Exercises belonging to a workout with user_max and order; indexed by workout_id + user_id.

nodes.label: logs table
nodes.summary: Set logs with weight, reps, rpe, date; indexed by exercise/workout/user/date.

nodes.label: nutrition_entries table
nodes.summary: Daily nutrition entries with macros, is_photo, photo_uri; indexed by user_id + date.

nodes.label: nutrition_entry_ingredients table
nodes.summary: Ingredient rows FK'd to nutrition_entries with per-ingredient macros.

nodes.label: saved_nutrition_entries table
nodes.summary: Reusable saved meal templates indexed by user_id, with child ingredient table.

nodes.label: Progress Tab / Graphs
nodes.summary: Progress screen with Victory charts, ProgressWheel, GraphStats, and a 7/14/21-day range selector.

nodes.label: ActivityBanner
nodes.summary: Shows activity level, nutrition streak, and week's workout days; reads from Settings and Nutrition contexts.

nodes.label: Camera / AI Photo Flow
nodes.summary: Capture photo, compress, send to OpenAI vision, show analyzingModal, then create hydrated nutrition entry.
